name: Project Addict
flavorText: You have spent entire sessions on a single move and called it a good day. Falling isn't discouraging, it's data. You will absolutely be the last person to leave the gym tonight.
favouriteHold: The hold you keep falling off
villainLine: They've talked about training for this move more than you've actually tried it. You have no patience for that.
partnerLine: You bring the relentless attempts, they bring the target grade — your projects finally have a goal.
